Applicants must hold a Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Electronics Engineering or Production Engineering from a recognized University/ Institution, and the notified pay for the post is Level-6. content_sections.heading: Indian Coast Guard Chargeman at a Glance

rows.details: Chargeman (General Central Service, Group B, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial)
Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Electronics Engineering or Production Engineering

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must send their application form filled either in English or Hindi as per the prescribed format given at Annexure-1 with a duly affixed self-attested colour photograph. The application must be accompanied by photocopies of the required documents, self-attested with name and date. No original certificates are to be forwarded along with the application form. Applicants are to enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp (pasted on the envelope) addressed to themselves with the application. The envelope containing the application should be clearly super-scribed in BOLD letters with notation "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF CHARGEMAN" and also the category under which they applied. The fully filled application with all the necessary attachments must be sent by ordinary post only to the following address: The Director General, (For PD (Rectt))Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment,C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector-62, Noida, U.P. - 201309

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: A Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Marine or Electronics Engineering or Production Engineering from a recognized University/ Institution. Two years experience in the field of hull repair or general engineering and/or in electrical or electronics trades. Age Limit: Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 30 years. Age Relaxation: Relaxable by 05 years for SC candidates against reserved vacancies and 10 years for PwBD candidates (15 years for SC PwBD candidate). Relaxable for Government servants upto five years in accordance with the instruction or orders issued by the Central Government.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Aadhaar card Matriculation or equivalent marksheet and certificate UG/PG/Diploma marksheet and certificate Latest Category Certificate for reserved category candidates Experience Certificate PwBD Certificate (if applicable) NOC from the employer for candidates presently serving in any government organization (if applicable) Two latest passport size colour photographs A separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp addressed to themselves

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises Scrutiny of applications, Document Verification, and Written Examination. Written Examination: All shortlisted candidates will undergo a written examination on the basis of educational qualification prescribed for the post. The written examination will be pen-paper based and bilingual, consisting of 80 objective type questions with one mark for each correct answer and no negative marking. The subjects are Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), Science (20 questions, 20 marks), General Awareness (15 questions, 15 marks), English (15 questions, 15 marks), and Mental Ability/Reasoning (10 questions, 10 marks), with a duration of 01 Hour.

faq.question: Q1. Who gets an age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: Age is relaxable by 05 years for SC candidates against reserved vacancies and 10 years for PwBD candidates (15 years for SC PwBD candidate). Government servants receive relaxation up to five years as per instructions issued by the Central Government.

faq.question: Q2. Which documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose Aadhaar card, matriculation marksheet and certificate, UG/PG/Diploma marksheet and certificate, latest category certificate, experience certificate, PwBD certificate if applicable, NOC if serving in government service, two latest passport size photographs, and a separate blank envelope with a Rs. 50/- postal stamp addressed to themselves.
